name: gridplayer
readme_summary: GridPlayer is a cross-platform media player built with Python and PyQt5, utilizing the VLC library. It allows users to play multiple videos simultaneously in a configurable grid layout, supporting a wide range of video formats and streaming URLs through integrations with Streamlink and yt-dlp.
key_features: Support for any video and audio format (VLC)
Support for (almost) any streaming URLs (Streamlink + yt-dlp)
Control video aspect, playback speed, zoom
Set loop fragments with frame precision
Playlist retains settings for each video
primary_use_case: Playing multiple video streams or files concurrently in a synchronized or independently controlled grid layout.
cover_image_prompt: A conductor orchestrating a symphony of screens, each displaying a different video feed. The conductor, representing the GridPlayer application, uses a digital baton to control the playback, volume, and layout of each individual video screen arranged in a neat grid. Subtle glowing lines connect the baton to the screens, indicating control. Small icons representing different video formats and streaming services float around the scene. The background is a minimalist, modern studio with soft, ambient lighting. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with vibrant colors and clear, distinct elements, emphasizing the organized and simultaneous playback of multiple video streams.

name: vibe
readme_summary: Vibe is a cross-platform desktop application that allows users to transcribe audio and video files locally on their device. It supports a wide range of languages, output formats, and AI models, offering features like batch processing, real-time preview, summarization, and translation.
key_features: Supports multiple languages and audio/video file types
Integration with AI models (Whisper, Nemotron, Parakeet) and Ollama for local analysis
Cross-platform compatibility (macOS, Windows, Linux) with GPU optimization
primary_use_case: Local, private, and efficient transcription of audio and video files with advanced AI processing capabilities.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old owl perched on a stack of audio and video tapes, meticulously transcribing the sounds into glowing digital text that floats around it. The owl's eyes are bright screens displaying waveforms and transcription progress. Subtle digital particles emanate from the tapes, representing the raw audio data being processed. In the background, a clean, minimalist desk with a small monitor showing the 'Vibe' logo and a few different file format icons (SRT, VTT, TXT). The scene is bathed in soft, ambient light, emphasizing the quiet focus of the transcription process. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a warm, inviting color palette, conveying both intelligence and user-friendliness.

name: Tabminal
description: Tab(ter)minal, a Cloud-Native terminal and ACP agent workspace for desktop, tablet, and phone.
readme_summary: Tabminal is a cloud-native terminal and workspace application designed for seamless use across desktop, tablet, and phone devices. It integrates persistent server-side terminal sessions, a built-in file and agent workspace, and support for the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) to provide a rich, intelligent, and persistent coding experience.
key_features: Built-in workspace tabs (files, images, agents, terminals)
Browser-first mobile and tablet UX (PWA support)
primary_use_case: To provide a unified, persistent, and cross-device terminal and development workspace experience, enabling users to code and manage systems from any device.
cover_image_prompt: A digital cartographer meticulously drawing a vast, interconnected network of glowing pathways on a transparent globe that hovers above a sleek, modern desk. Each pathway represents a persistent terminal session, and small, illuminated icons of code editors, file folders, and agent interfaces are embedded along these routes. The cartographer uses a stylus that emits streams of data, connecting different points on the globe, symbolizing multi-host access and ACP integrations. Subtle UI elements of the Tabminal interface are visible on a nearby tablet screen, showcasing the unified workspace. The overall mood is one of organized complexity and accessible power, rendered in a vibrant, futuristic digital painting style with a focus on glowing lines and clear, intuitive iconography.

name: robin
readme_summary: Robin is an AI-powered tool designed for dark web Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) investigations. It utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance search queries, filter results from dark web search engines, and generate concise investigation summaries.
key_features: Multi-Model LLM Support (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, etc.)
primary_use_case: Conducting AI-assisted open-source intelligence investigations on the dark web.
cover_image_prompt: A digital detective, cloaked in shadows but illuminated by a soft, glowing interface, sifts through a swirling vortex of dark web data. The vortex is composed of abstract representations of hidden forums and marketplaces. The detective uses an AI-powered magnifying glass that highlights key pieces of information, transforming chaotic data streams into organized, insightful reports visualized as clean, glowing charts and text snippets. Subtle UI elements and code fragments float around the scene, hinting at the tool's technical nature. The overall mood is mysterious yet focused, with a color palette of deep blues, purples, and glowing accents. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a focus on conceptual clarity.

name: secureml
description: Easy-to-use utilities to build privacy-preserving AI.
readme_summary: SecureML is a Python library designed to build privacy-preserving AI applications. It offers utilities for data anonymization, differential privacy, federated learning, and synthetic data generation, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations like GDPR.
key_features: Audit Trails and Reporting (HTML/PDF reports, Dashboards)
primary_use_case: Enabling developers to build AI applications that handle sensitive data in a privacy-preserving and compliant manner.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing a vast library of sensitive data scrolls. The librarian uses a special magnifying glass that glows with a soft, protective aura, revealing hidden patterns and anonymizing personal details on the scrolls before they are safely filed. Some scrolls are being transformed into abstract, generalized forms, representing synthetic data. Small, subtle digital interfaces float around, displaying compliance checklists and privacy metrics. The overall mood is one of secure knowledge and responsible data handling, rendered in a warm, inviting 3D isometric illustration style with clear iconography and a focus on the librarian's careful work.
